newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya extends anti-corruption sweep to oil - JANA.
newsitem.headline: Libya extends anti-corruption sweep to oil - JANA.

text.p: An anti-corruption sweep driven by followers of Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi had been extended to companies operating in the oil sector, the official Libyan news agency JANA reported on Monday.
"On the basis of the law on Purification, a commitee for Purification in the oil sector was formed," JANA, monitored in Tunis, said.

"The committee, for which a decision was issued by the Secretary (Minister) of the General Popular Committee (Ministry) of Justice and Public order, includes a number of engineers and experts," it added.
JANA said the Committee had already started its mission.
"Some circles in the oil sector fear that the activities of this committee could affect the operations of export of Libyan oil and its arrival to its markets and clients," JANA added.

Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi said in a speech on September 2 that anti-corruption committees -- formed at his demand all around the country, including within the army -- had ordered the arrest of several people since they started their probes during the last two months.
